comments.content: File is decoded via chardet/iconv without first checking if the file is binary. Binary files will be decoded as text, producing garbled content and possible errors. Add an isBinaryFile guard before detection/decoding, similar to extract-text.

The file is only written back when fileEncoding.toLowerCase() !== 'utf8'. For UTF-8 files the write is skipped entirely, so edits are silently lost. Write the file in all cases, encoding with the detected encoding or defaulting to utf8.

The entire file is read into memory with fs.readFile before size and binary checks. This defeats the early 300KB guard and can load large or binary files fully into memory and then attempt to decode them. Check size via stat and binary status before reading, or guard binary detection before decoding.
